items.stem: What does the man say he never really understood?

choices.text: Why Roman Holiday was more famous than Breakfast at Tiffany's.
choices.zh: 为什么《罗马假日》比《蒂凡尼的早餐》更有名。

choices.text: Why Audrey Hepburn had more female fans than male ones.
choices.zh: 为什么Audrey Hepburn的女性影迷多于男性影迷。

choices.text: Why the woman wanted to be like Audrey Hepburn.
choices.zh: 为什么这位女士想要成为像Audrey Hepburn那样的人。

choices.text: Why so many girls adored Audrey Hepburn.
choices.zh: 为什么那么多女孩崇拜Audrey Hepburn。

items.stem: What prevented Audrey Hepburn from becoming a professional dancer?

choices.text: Her unique personality.
choices.zh: 她独特的个性。

choices.text: Her physical condition.
choices.zh: 她的身体状况。

choices.text: Her shift of interest to performing arts.
choices.zh: 她的兴趣转向了表演艺术。

choices.text: Her family's suspension of financial aid.
choices.zh: 她的家庭中断了经济资助。

items.stem: What do we learn about Audrey Hepburn in real life?

choices.text: She was not an outgoing person.
choices.zh: 她不是一个外向的人。

choices.text: She was modest and hardworking.
choices.zh: 她谦逊且勤奋。

choices.text: She was easy-going on the whole.
choices.zh: 她总体上随和。

choices.text: She was usually not very optimistic.
choices.zh: 她通常不太乐观。

items.stem: Why did Audrey Hepburn devote much of her life to charity after her acting career?

choices.text: She was influenced by the roles she played in the films.
choices.zh: 她受到自己在电影中扮演的角色的影响。

choices.text: Her parents taught her to sympathize with the needy.
choices.zh: 她的父母教导她同情有需要的人。

choices.text: She learned to volunteer when she was a child.
choices.zh: 她小时候就学会了做志愿者。

choices.text: Her family benefited from other people's help.
choices.zh: 她的家庭受益于他人的帮助。

items.stem: What is the man going to do?

choices.text: Give a presentation.
choices.zh: 做一个陈述。

choices.text: Raise some questions.
choices.zh: 提出一些问题。

choices.text: Start a new company.
choices.zh: 创办一家新公司。

choices.text: Attend a board meeting.
choices.zh: 参加董事会会议。

items.stem: What does the man say about the restructuring?

choices.text: It will cut production costs.
choices.zh: 它将降低生产成本。

choices.text: It will raise productivity.
choices.zh: 它将提高生产率。

choices.text: No staff will be dismissed.
choices.zh: 不会有员工被解雇。

choices.text: No new staff will be hired.
choices.zh: 不会招聘新员工。

items.stem: What will the man explain first?

choices.text: The timeline of restructuring.
choices.zh: 重组的时间表。

choices.text: The reasons for restructuring.
choices.zh: 重组的原因。

choices.text: The communication channels.
choices.zh: 沟通渠道。

choices.text: The company's new missions.
choices.zh: 公司的新使命。

items.stem: How can the staff learn more about the company's restructuring?

choices.text: By consulting their own department managers.
choices.zh: 通过咨询他们自己的部门经理。

choices.text: By emailing questions to the man or the woman.
choices.zh: 通过给这位男士或这位女士发送电子邮件提问。

choices.text: By exploring various channels of communication.
choices.zh: 通过探索各种沟通渠道。

choices.text: By visiting the company's own computer network.
choices.zh: 通过访问公司自己的计算机网络。

items.stem: What is special about the Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky international airport?

choices.text: It helps passengers to take care of their pet animals.
choices.zh: 它帮助乘客照顾他们的宠物。

choices.text: It has animals to help passengers carry their language.
choices.zh: 它有动物帮助乘客搬运行李。

choices.text: It uses therapy animals to soothe nervous passengers.
choices.zh: 它使用治疗动物来安抚紧张的乘客。

choices.text: It allows passengers to have animals travels with them.
choices.zh: 它允许乘客携带动物一起旅行。

items.stem: What are the trained animals probably capable of doing in an airport?

choices.text: Avoiding possible dangers.
choices.zh: 避免可能的危险。

choices.text: Finding their way around.
choices.zh: 找到周围的路。

choices.text: Identifying drug smugglers.
choices.zh: 识别毒品走私者。

choices.text: Looking after sick passengers.
choices.zh: 照顾生病的乘客。

items.stem: What do some passengers try to do?

choices.text: Schedule their flights around the animal visits.
choices.zh: 围绕动物探访安排他们的航班。

choices.text: Photograph the therapy animals at the airport.
choices.zh: 在机场拍摄治疗动物。

choices.text: Keep some animals for therapeutic purposes.
choices.zh: 为治疗目的饲养一些动物。

choices.text: Bring their animals on board their plane.
choices.zh: 把他们的动物带上飞机。

items.stem: Where is the speaker standing?

choices.text: Beside a beautifully painted wall in Arles.
choices.zh: 在阿尔勒一面绘有精美图画的墙壁旁边。

choices.text: Beside the gate of an ancient Roman city.
choices.zh: 在一座古罗马城市的大门旁边。

choices.text: At the site of an ancient Roman mansion.
choices.zh: 在一座古罗马宅邸的遗址处。

choices.text: At the entrance to a reception hall in Rome.
choices.zh: 在罗马一个接待大厅的入口处。

items.stem: What do the thousands of fragments display when they are put back together?

choices.text: A number of different images.
choices.zh: 许多不同的图像。

choices.text: A number of mythological heroes.
choices.zh: 许多神话英雄。

choices.text: Various musical instruments.
choices.zh: 各种乐器。

choices.text: Paintings by famous French artists.
choices.zh: 法国著名艺术家的画作。

items.stem: What makes experts think the paintings were done by artists from Italy?

choices.text: The originality and expertise shown.
choices.zh: 所展现的独创性和专业技艺。

choices.text: The worldly sophistication displayed.
choices.zh: 所展现的世俗老练。

choices.text: The stunning images vividly depicted.
choices.zh: 所描绘的令人惊叹的生动图像。

choices.text: The impressive skills and costly dyes.
choices.zh: 令人印象深刻的技艺和昂贵的染料。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the owner of the mansion?

choices.text: His artistic taste is superb.
choices.zh: 他的艺术品味极佳。

choices.text: His identity remains unclear.
choices.zh: 他的身份仍不清楚。

choices.text: He was a collector of antiques.
choices.zh: 他是一位古董收藏家。

choices.text: He was a rich Italian merchant.
choices.zh: 他是一位富有的意大利商人。

items.stem: What do we learn about the research funding policies in the European Union?

choices.text: They encourage international cooperation.
choices.zh: 它们鼓励国际合作。

choices.text: They lay stress on basic scientific research.
choices.zh: 它们强调基础科学研究。

choices.text: They place great emphasis on empirical studies.
choices.zh: 它们非常重视实证研究。

choices.text: They favour scientists from its member countries.
choices.zh: 它们偏向来自其成员国的科学家。

items.stem: Why do researchers today favor international collaboration?

choices.text: Many of them wish to win international recognition.
choices.zh: 他们中的许多人希望赢得国际认可。

choices.text: They believe that more hands will make light work.
choices.zh: 他们相信人多好办事。

choices.text: They want to follow closely the international trend.
choices.zh: 他们想要紧跟国际趋势。

choices.text: Many of their projects have become complicated.
choices.zh: 他们的许多项目已经变得复杂。

items.stem: What do we learn about the field of mathematics?

choices.text: It requires mathematicians to work independently.
choices.zh: 它要求数学家独立工作。

choices.text: It is faced with many unprecedented challenges.
choices.zh: 它面临许多前所未有的挑战。

choices.text: It lags behind other disciplines in collaboration.
choices.zh: 它在合作方面落后于其他学科。

choices.text: It calls for more research funding to catch up.
choices.zh: 它需要更多科研资金才能赶上。

items.stem: What do we learn from the Life magazine article?

choices.text: Scientists tried to send a balloon to Venus.
choices.zh: 科学家试图向金星发射气球。

choices.text: Scientists discovered water on Venus.
choices.zh: 科学家在金星上发现了水。

choices.text: Scientists found Venus had atmosphere.
choices.zh: 科学家发现金星有大气层。

choices.text: Scientists observed Venus from a space vehicle.
choices.zh: 科学家从太空飞行器上观测金星。

items.stem: What are scientists' findings about Venus?

choices.text: It resembles Earth in many aspects.
choices.zh: 它在许多方面与地球相似。

choices.text: It is the same as fiction has portrayed.
choices.zh: 它与科幻小说所描绘的一样。

choices.text: It is a paradise of romance for alien life.
choices.zh: 它是外星生命的浪漫天堂。

choices.text: It undergoes geological changes like Earth.
choices.zh: 它像地球一样经历地质变化。

items.stem: What information did Russian and American space probes provide about Venus?

choices.text: It might have been hotter than it is today.
choices.zh: 它过去可能比现在更热。

choices.text: It might have been a cozy habitat for life.
choices.zh: 它过去可能是生命的宜居栖息地。

choices.text: It used to have more water than Earth.
choices.zh: 它过去拥有比地球更多的水。

choices.text: It used to be covered with rainforests.
choices.zh: 它过去被雨林覆盖。

items.stem: What does the speaker mainly study?

choices.text: Causes of sleeplessness.
choices.zh: 失眠的原因。

choices.text: Cross-cultural communication.
choices.zh: 跨文化交流。

choices.text: Cultural psychology.
choices.zh: 文化心理学。

choices.text: Motivation and positive feelings.
choices.zh: 动机和积极情绪。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about North Americans?

choices.text: They attach great importance to sleep.
choices.zh: 他们非常重视睡眠。

choices.text: They often have trouble falling asleep.
choices.zh: 他们经常难以入睡。

choices.text: They pay more attention to sleep efficiency.
choices.zh: 他们更关注睡眠效率。

choices.text: They generally sleep longer than East Asians.
choices.zh: 他们通常比东亚人睡得更久。

items.stem: How did the speaker conduct the sleep study?

choices.text: By asking people to report their sleep habits.
choices.zh: 通过让人们报告他们的睡眠习惯。

choices.text: By observing people's sleep patterns in labs.
choices.zh: 通过在实验室观察人们的睡眠模式。

choices.text: By having people wear motion-detecting watches.
choices.zh: 通过让人们佩戴运动检测手表。

choices.text: By videotaping people's daily sleeping processes.
choices.zh: 通过录像记录人们的日常睡眠过程。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about research on sleep?

choices.text: It has made remarkable progress in the past few decades.
choices.zh: 它在过去几十年取得了显著进展。

choices.text: It has not yet explored the cross-cultural aspect of sleep.
choices.zh: 它尚未探索睡眠的跨文化方面。

choices.text: It has not yet produced anything conclusive.
choices.zh: 它尚未产生任何确定性结论。

choices.text: It has attached attention all over the world.
choices.zh: 它引起了全世界的关注。
